title: Add Telemetry Data Point
objective: Learn how to add a parameter to an Electronic Data Sheet telemetry message
payload definition and telemeter the value.

exercise.instructions:
1. Locate the <ContainerDataType> named 'HkTlm_Payload'. Add the following entry to StatusTlm_Payload's <EntryList>:
    Entry name='ExampleCmdParam' type='BASE_TYPES/int16'

Note the GUI needs to be restarted after building the new lesson cFS target.

1. Locate the @TEMPLATE@_ExampleParamCmd()function and after the '@TEMPLATE@_Data.CommandCounter++;'line add:
    @TEMPLATE@_Data.ExampleCmdParam = Msg->Payload.ValI16;

2. Locate the @TEMPLATE@_SendHkCmd()function and after the 'command execution counter' lines add:
    @TEMPLATE@_Data.HkTlm.Payload.ExampleCmdParam = @TEMPLATE@_Data.ExampleCmdParam;
